title: The Clearing House Picks Quant For US Tokenized Deposit Network
summary: The Clearing House has selected Quant to provide the interoperability and transaction-management layer for its On-Chain Money Initiative. The planned network will let financial institutions clear and settle tokenized deposits while connecting to existing RTP and CHIPS payment rails. Participating institutions are expected to gain access in the first half of 2027. **ID:** N25-06 **Site:** NewsBTC **Status:** READY **Author:** NewsBTC Editorial Team **Focus Keyword:** Quant **Image Keyword:** Tokenization **Category:** Technology **Tags:** Quant, The Clearing House, Tokenized Deposits, RTP, CHIPS **Primary Source:** https://www.theclearinghouse.org/payment-systems/articles/2026/09/quant-selected-for-on-chain-money-initiative Tokenized Deposits Meet RTP And CHIPS The Clearing House operates some of the core plumbing of the U.S. financial system. Its networks clear and settle more than $2 trillion per day across wire transfers, ACH, checks and real-time payments. The On-Chain Money Initiative is intended to add tokenized deposits to that environment. Quant’s role will be to coordinate how those tokenized deposits move between participating financial institutions while connecting the network to existing fiat rails including RTP and CHIPS. That creates a different model from a public stablecoin. A tokenized deposit remains a deposit liability of the bank that issued it. The blockchain component changes how that claim can be recorded, programmed and transferred. The underlying banking relationship remains. Programmable Bank Money Is Moving Closer To Production The initiative was first announced in June. The selection of Quant moves it from a broad banking project toward a specific technology architecture. The Clearing House says the system could support corporate treasury, liquidity management, cross-border payments and digital-asset settlement. Payments could also be programmed to execute automatically once agreed conditions are met. Participating institutions are expected to gain access in the first half of 2027. That means this is infrastructure under development, not a live consumer payment network today. Still, the scale of the organization behind it matters. Blockchain experiments inside individual banks are nothing new. A shared tokenized-deposit network attached to payment rails already used across the U.S. banking system is a different proposition. If the project works, banks would not need to choose between existing payment infrastructure and programmable onchain money. The two systems could increasingly become part of the same stack. *This article was written by the News Desk and edited by [Samuel Rae](https://www.newsbtc.com/author/rae-samuel/).*
content: The Clearing House has selected Quant to provide interoperability for its On-Chain Money Initiative. title: Solana Foundation Hires Former Binance CMO For Institutional Push
summary: The Solana Foundation has appointed former Binance global CMO Rachel Conlan as chief strategy officer. Former Polygon Labs executive Jamal Raees has joined as general manager of payments. The Foundation says the hires are aimed at accelerating institutional adoption and payment activity on Solana. **ID:** N25-07 **Site:** NewsBTC **Status:** READY **Author:** NewsBTC Editorial Team **Focus Keyword:** Solana **Image Keyword:** Solana **Category:** Altcoins **Tags:** Solana, Rachel Conlan, Payments, Institutions, Foundation **Primary Source:** https://solana.com/news Solana Wants To Turn Network Activity Into Institutional Adoption Conlan spent three years as Binance’s global CMO and previously held senior roles at OKX, CAA Sports and Havas. At Solana, her remit will extend beyond marketing. The Foundation says she will oversee institutional partnerships, ecosystem growth and go-to-market strategy. Raees will focus more narrowly on payments. His role covers stablecoins, tokenized deposits and the broader infrastructure required to make Solana useful as a financial settlement network. The appointments arrive as the Foundation points to substantial growth across those areas. It says Solana has processed more than $5 trillion in stablecoin volume during 2026, while real-world assets on the network have passed $4.5 billion and tokenized equity supply has moved above $620 million. Those are company-reported ecosystem figures, but they explain why the Foundation is building a team specifically around institutional finance. Solana Is Competing For Financial Infrastructure, Not Just Crypto Apps Solana’s earlier growth story was heavily associated with trading, NFTs and consumer crypto applications. The network is increasingly positioning itself around payments, tokenization and institutional settlement as well. That brings it into a different competitive set. Ethereum and its Layer 2 networks remain deeply embedded in tokenized finance, while newer payment-focused chains and private banking networks are chasing many of the same use cases. Solana’s pitch is performance: high throughput, low transaction costs and an existing pool of stablecoin liquidity. But technology alone does not bring institutions onchain. Banks, asset managers and payment companies require partnerships, compliance integration and people who can translate blockchain infrastructure into products that fit existing financial businesses. The Foundation’s latest hires suggest it knows that. Solana already has the network. Conlan and Raees are being brought in to help turn that network into something more institutions and payment companies actually use. *This article was written by the News Desk and edited by [Samuel Rae](https://www.newsbtc.com/author/rae-samuel/).*
content: The Solana Foundation has appointed former Binance global CMO Rachel Conlan as chief strategy officer and former Polygon Labs executive Jamal Raees as general manager of payments. These high-profile hires are part of a strategic push to accelerate institutional adoption, expand payment activity, and drive financial settlement infrastructure growth across the Solana network.
content_ta: Solana Foundation, முன்னாள் Binance global CMO-வான Rachel Conlan-ஐ chief strategy officer-ாகவும், முன்னாள் Polygon Labs executive-ரான Jamal Raees-ஐ general manager of payments-ாகவும் நியமித்துள்ளது. Solana நெட்வொர்க்கில் நிறுவனங்களின் ஏற்பாட்டை விரைவுபடுத்துவதற்கும், கட்டணச் செயல்பாடுகளை விரிவுபடுத்துவதற்கும் இந்த நியமனங்கள் செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளன.

title: HIFI Raises $37M To Build Stablecoin And Tokenized Market Infrastructure
summary: HIFI has raised a $37 million Series A led by Left Lane Capital. The company says the funding will expand stablecoin payments, cards and infrastructure for tokenized capital markets. HIFI says its platform currently processes more than $7 billion in annualized volume across 87 countries. **ID:** N25-08 **Site:** NewsBTC **Status:** READY **Author:** NewsBTC Editorial Team **Focus Keyword:** HIFI **Image Keyword:** Payments **Category:** Technology **Tags:** HIFI, Stablecoins, Tokenization, Payments, Funding **Primary Source:** https://www.hifibridge.com/blog HIFI Wants To Connect Bank Money, Stablecoins And Tokenized Assets HIFI provides APIs designed to connect traditional bank rails with stablecoin settlement. The company says its infrastructure currently processes more than $7 billion in annualized volume across 87 countries. That business started largely around moving money. The next stage is broader. HIFI says the Series A will help expand card products, stablecoin payments and infrastructure used around tokenized securities and capital-market transactions. The company participated in DTCC’s July production trades involving DTC-tokenized assets alongside firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs and Nasdaq. It has also partnered with Visa on stablecoin-funded payouts that can reach billions of Visa cards. Those integrations give HIFI a position between the blockchain layer and the financial institutions that ultimately need cash settlement, compliance and distribution. Tokenized Markets Still Need A Cash Side Much of the attention around tokenization goes to the asset. A Treasury security, stock or fund share gets represented onchain and suddenly the transaction looks modern. But every trade still has another side. Someone needs to deliver the money. That is where stablecoin infrastructure becomes particularly interesting. Tokenized capital markets work far better if the cash leg can move with the same speed and programmability as the security being traded. HIFI is betting that the infrastructure connecting those two sides can become a substantial financial-services business. The $37 million round does not come with a disclosed valuation. It does provide the company with more capital to build into a market where traditional payments, stablecoins and securities settlement are increasingly converging. Stablecoins used to be mostly a way for crypto traders to hold dollars between trades. Companies like HIFI are betting the bigger opportunity is making them part of the infrastructure underneath everything else. *This article was written by the News Desk and edited by [Samuel Rae](https://www.newsbtc.com/author/rae-samuel/).*
content: HIFI has raised a $37 million Series A funding round led by Left Lane Capital. summary:

content: The European Union faces a September 30 deadline to determine the future framework for DeFi loans. Its response to the MiCA review addresses crypto firms' access routes, while any new lending obligations remain a matter for future legislation, according to recent updates from the sector.
content_ta: DeFi loans-களின் எதிர்காலத்தை தீர்மானிக்க ஐரோப்பிய யூனியன் செப்டம்பர் 30-ஆம் தேதியை கெடுவாக நிர்ணயித்துள்ளது. MiCA மீளாய்வுக்கான அதன் பதில் கிரிப்டோ நிறுவனங்களின் அணுகல் வழிகளைக் குறிக்கிறது, அதே நேரத்தில் புதிய கடன் வழங்கும் கடமைகள் எதிர்கால சட்டமன்றத் தேர்வாகவே இருக்கும்.

title: Bitget Confirms $351.6M Hot Wallet Breach And Pauses Withdrawals
summary: Bitget says unauthorized transfers affected approximately $351.6 million held across parts of its hot and warm wallet infrastructure. The exchange says its cold wallets were not affected and its $464 million-plus User Protection Fund covers the loss. Withdrawals have been temporarily suspended while Bitget investigates the breach with law enforcement and security firms. **ID:** N25-10 **Site:** NewsBTC **Status:** READY **Author:** NewsBTC Editorial Team **Focus Keyword:** Bitget **Image Keyword:** Security **Category:** Technology **Tags:** Bitget, Security, Hack, Exchange, Wallets **Primary Source:** https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/ Bitget Says Cold Wallets And Customer Balances Remain Secure According to Bitget’s security notice, the incident was contained to part of its hot and warm wallet layers. Cold wallets were not compromised. The exchange says customer balances remain accurate and that the entire estimated loss falls within its User Protection Fund, which currently holds more than $464 million. Withdrawals have been temporarily suspended while the security review continues. Deposits and trading remain available. Bitget says it has identified and flagged abnormal transfer addresses and has contacted law enforcement and onchain security firms. The company has promised a full incident report, including root-cause analysis, within 24 hours. Until that report arrives, Bitget is deliberately not speculating publicly about how the attackers gained access. The Size Of The Protection Fund Is About To Be Tested Exchange protection funds sound reassuring when markets are calm. A major exploit is when they become meaningful. Bitget’s stated $464 million-plus fund is larger than the current $351.6 million estimate, which means the company says it can absorb the incident without passing losses to customers. That does not remove the operational problem. Withdrawals being paused means users temporarily cannot move assets off the platform, and the final loss figure or attack scope could change as the investigation develops. The breach also reinforces the distinction between exchange custody and self-custody. Assets held in an exchange hot wallet depend on the exchange’s security systems, operational controls and balance sheet. Bitget says its separate self-custodial Bitget Wallet infrastructure was not involved. For now, the key questions are straightforward: how the attacker gained access, whether all affected wallets have been contained and when withdrawals can safely resume. A $351.6 million loss is large enough that the promised root-cause report will matter far beyond Bitget’s own users. *This article was written by the News Desk and edited by [Samuel Rae](https://www.newsbtc.com/author/rae-samuel/).*
content: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget has confirmed a security breach affecting its hot and warm wallet infrastructure, resulting in approximately $351.6 million in unauthorized transfers. The exchange stated that its cold wallets and customer balances remain secure, and its User Protection Fund will cover the losses. Withdrawals have been temporarily suspended while Bitget investigates the incident with law enforcement and security firms.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி பரிமாற்ற நிறுவனமான Bitget தனது ஹாட் மற்றும் வார்ம் வாலட் கட்டமைப்பில் பாதுகாப்பு மீறல் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதை உறுதிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இதனால் சுமார் 351.6 மில்லியன் டாலர் மதிப்புள்ள சொத்துக்கள் அங்கீகரிக்கப்படாமல் மாற்றப்பட்டுள்ளன. கோல்ட் வாலட்கள் மற்றும் வாடிக்கையாளர்களின் இருப்புக்கள் பாதுகாப்பாக இருப்பதாகவும், பயனர் பாதுகாப்பு நிதியைக் கொண்டு இழப்புகள் ஈடுகட்டப்படும் என்றும் நிறுவனம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. பாதுகாப்பு நிறுவனங்கள் மற்றும் காவல்துறையுடன் இணைந்து Bitget விசாரணை நடத்தி வருவதால், தற்காலிகமாகப் பணம் எடுக்கும் வசதி (withdrawals) நிறுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Paxos Labs Launches Gold Token That Can Earn A Return In Gold
summary: Paxos Labs has launched PAXGy, a token backed by PAXG that can increase in value relative to gold over time. The underlying reserves are deployed to vetted institutional borrowers through the gold-leasing market. PAXGy is live across platforms including OKX, X Layer, Uniswap, 0x and Ether.Fi, but the return is not guaranteed. **ID:** N25-09 **Site:** NewsBTC **Status:** READY **Author:** NewsBTC Editorial Team **Focus Keyword:** Paxos **Image Keyword:** Gold **Category:** Altcoins **Tags:** Paxos, PAXG, PAXGy, Gold, Tokenization **Primary Source:** https://www.paxos.com/blog The Token Balance Stays The Same While Its Gold Value Can Grow PAXGy is backed by PAXG. Each PAXG represents physical gold held in institutional custody, with the underlying reserves subject to regular attestation. PAXGy adds another layer. Paxos Labs says holders can deposit PAXG or swap supported stablecoins for PAXGy. The reserves backing PAXGy can then be lent to vetted institutional borrowers in the bullion market. When those strategies generate a return, that value accrues through the PAXGy exchange rate. The holder’s number of tokens does not have to increase. Instead, each PAXGy can become redeemable for more PAXG over time. That is a very different model from simply holding tokenized bullion. Yield Also Introduces Risk That Plain Gold Does Not Have There is no free yield here. Paxos Labs explicitly warns that deploying gold into external strategies introduces credit, liquidity and market risks. If borrowers default or the underlying strategies suffer losses, the PAXGy exchange rate can move downward. Growth is not guaranteed. That distinction matters because PAXG and PAXGy may sound almost identical while representing different risk profiles. PAXG is designed around direct exposure to physical gold. PAXGy adds a yield-generating strategy on top of that exposure. The token is launching with support from OKX, X Layer, 0x, Uniswap, Ether.Fi and Chainlink. Paxos Labs says tokenized gold has now grown beyond $5 billion in total value, while trading volume during the first quarter of 2026 exceeded the whole of 2025. PAXGy is an attempt to make that market more financially productive. Instead of tokenizing gold simply so it can move onchain, the product tries to connect it to a centuries-old lending market as well. It is another example of tokenization starting to recreate financial functions around an asset, not merely digitize ownership of it. *This article was written by the News Desk and edited by [Samuel Rae](https://www.newsbtc.com/author/rae-samuel/).*
content: Paxos Labs has launched PAXGy, a new token backed by PAXG that aims to generate returns through the gold-leasing market. The token allows holders to earn value relative to gold by lending underlying reserves to vetted institutional borrowers. However, the yield is not guaranteed and introduces credit and market risks compared to holding physical gold. PAXGy is now supported across multiple platforms including OKX, Uniswap, and Ether.Fi.
content_ta: தங்கக் குத்தகை சந்தை மூலம் வருமானம் ஈர்க்கும் வகையில் PAXG ஆதரவுடன் PAXGy என்ற புதிய டோக்கனை Paxos Labs வெளியிட்டுள்ளது. நிறுவனக் கடன் வாங்குபவர்களுக்கு இருப்புகளை வழங்குவதன் மூலம் தங்கத்தின் மதிப்பை அதிகரிக்க இந்த டோக்கன் அனுமதிக்கிறது. எனினும், இதன் மூலம் கிடைக்கும் லாபம் உத்தரவாதம் அளிக்கப்படவில்லை மற்றும் இது சில சந்தை அபாயங்களை கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த PAXGy டோக்கன் OKX, Uniswap மற்றும் Ether.Fi உள்ளிட்ட பல்வேறு தளங்களில் கிடைக்கிறது.

title: Fed Moves to Tighten Stablecoin Rules With Two New GENIUS Act Proposals
summary: Public comments on the Fed's two stablecoin proposals will remain open for 60 days after publication in the Federal Register.
content: The Federal Reserve has introduced two new proposals aimed at tightening regulations on stablecoins under the GENIUS Act. Public feedback on these regulatory measures will be collected during a 60-day comment period following their official publication in the Federal Register.
content_ta: GENIUS Act-ன் கீழ் stablecoins மீதான விதிமுறைகளை கடுமையாக்க Fed இரண்டு புதிய proposals-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. Federal Register-ல் வெளியிட்ட பிறகு 60 நாட்களுக்கு பொதுமக்களின் கருத்துகள் பெறப்படும்.

title: Polygon price rises 12% since 100M POL burn—can it hold above $0.11?
summary: Polygon removed 100 million POL from circulation as its token climbed towards $0.115, leaving buyers with another resistance test.
content: Polygon saw its price climb by 12 percent following a massive token burn that removed 100 million POL from circulation. The cryptocurrency approached the $0.115 mark, sparking renewed interest among market participants. Traders are now watching closely to see if the digital asset can successfully maintain its momentum and hold above the critical $0.11 resistance level.
content_ta: 100 மில்லியன் POL டோக்கன்கள் புழக்கத்தில் இருந்து அழிக்கப்பட்டதைத் தொடர்ந்து, Polygon விலை 12 சதவீதம் உயர்ந்துள்ளது. இந்த கிரிப்டோகரன்சி $0.115 மதிப்பை நெருங்கியுள்ள நிலையில், வாங்குவோர் மத்தியில் புதிய எதிர்ப்புச் சோதனை உருவாகியுள்ளது. இந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து தனது விலையைத் தக்கவைத்துக்கொண்டு $0.11 என்ற முக்கியக் குறியீட்டுக்கு மேலே நிலைநிற்க முடியுமா என்பதை வர்த்தகர்கள் உன்னிப்பாகக் கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: Inventi Becomes First Swift Business Connect Provider in the Baltics
summary:
The Lithuanian payments platform can now offer banks and EMIs managed Swift connectivity alongside SEPA and TARGET through a single integration.
The post Inventi Becomes First Swift Business Connect Provider in the Baltics appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Lithuanian payments platform Inventi has become the first Swift Business Connect provider in the Baltics. content_ta: லித்துவேனியாவைச் சேர்ந்த கட்டண மேடையான Inventi, பால்டிக் பிராந்தியத்தில் முதல் Swift Business Connect வழங்குநராக மாறியுள்ளது. இந்நிறுவனம் இப்போது வங்கிகள் மற்றும் மின்னணு பண நிறுவனங்களுக்கு SEPA மற்றும் TARGET உடன் சேர்த்து நிர்வகிக்கப்பட்ட Swift இணைப்பை ஒற்றை ஒருங்கிணைப்பு மூலம் வழங்க முடியும்.

title: Nigeria’s FIRS Targets Crypto with Transaction Taxes and VASP Levies
summary:
New FIRS guidelines bring cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and virtual assets into Nigeria's tax net through transaction duties and withholding levies.
The post Nigeria’s FIRS Targets Crypto with Transaction Taxes and VASP Levies appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Nigeria's Federal Inland Revenue Service has introduced new guidelines aimed at bringing cryptocurrencies, stablecoins, and virtual assets into the country's tax net. The regulatory measures include transaction duties and withholding levies on virtual asset service providers, marking a significant step by the tax authority to monitor and generate revenue from digital asset activities within Nigeria.
content_ta: நைஜீரியாவின் FIRS அமைப்பு, கிரிப்டோகரன்சிகள், stablecoins மற்றும் மெய்நிகர் சொத்துக்களை நாட்டின் வரி வலையமைப்பிற்குள் கொண்டுவருவதற்கான புதிய வழிகாட்டுதல்களை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. VASP மீது பரிவர்த்தனை வரிகள் மற்றும் பிடிப்பு வரிகளை விதிக்கும் இந்த புதிய ஒழுங்குமுறை நடவடிக்கைகள், நைஜீரியாவில் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து செயல்பாடுகளைக் கண்காணித்து வருவாய் ஈட்டுவதில் வரி அதிகாரிகளின் முக்கிய நடவடிக்கையாகக் கருதப்படுகிறத்து.

content_ta: நஷ்டத்தில் இயங்கிய டிஜிட்டல் வாலட் ஆக இருந்த ஃபின்டெக் பிளாட்ஃபார்ம் GCash, தற்போது அதிக லாபம் ஈட்டும் வணிகமாக மாறி, தென்கிழக்கு ஆசிய தொழில்நுட்ப நிறுவனங்களின் வளர்ச்சி திறனை வெளிப்படுத்தியுள்ளது.
